periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Oblique orientation, angled approximately 45 degrees downward toward the medial facial axis.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Elongated ovoid morphology with the longitudinal axis significantly greater than the transverse axis.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Pronounced inferior-medial tapering, shifting the visual weight toward the snout.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Broad separation across the dorsal cranium, exceeding the width of an individual pinna.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Convex and semicircular with a smooth, rounded apex profile.

other_distinctive_markers: Significant brownish-yellow pigmentation across the ventral and inguinal pelage; exposed pinkish skin in the pelvic region.
